summary.answer: Compares numeric input against numeric Warzone maximum rank plus one. At/above threshold returns the special localized string; otherwise tostring(input). Missing numeric conversions are not guarded. Requires item model not dummy/collapsed. Reads selected slot and item id. If a slot-claiming pickup would replace a nonempty item, uses firstFreeSlot when not -1 or sends inventory_drop first when full. Then sends multi_item_pickup or multi_item_pickup_stowed_weapon with pickup id and chosen slot. These are clientscript requests; no authoritative inventory result is shown. Reads WarzoneSplitInventory.current and forwards controller/item/inventory_drop/amount to SendInventoryNotify. Errors if parent and child are identical. Stores parent[field] as a zero-argument closure; invocation calls child[field]() only if nonnil. It deliberately passes no implicit child receiver, and does not prove the d [excerpt; exact source record identified separately]
